name: Accordion
description: Stacks sections that expand one at a time, or several at once.

multiple.description: Let several items stay open at once; a single accordion closes the open item when another opens or when it is pressed again

onValueChange.description: Called with the open items - (value: string[], eventDetails) => void

children.description: Accordion items (use Accordion.Item with Accordion.Trigger and Accordion.Content)

headingLevel.description: Semantic heading level for accordion triggers

whenNot: A line or two — just show it
guidelines: Headers should say what is inside
Single mode when one answer at a time is enough
Multiple mode when sections get compared
Open the section most readers came for
Never nest an accordion inside an accordion
accessibility: Keyboard navigation with Enter/Space to toggle
Focus is visible on accordion triggers

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Opening one section closes the last.
examples.code:
import { Accordion } from '@/components/Accordion';

<Accordion defaultValue={['item-1']}>
  <Accordion.Item value="item-1">
    <Accordion.Trigger>What is Fragments UI?</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Fragments UI is a modern React component library built on Base UI primitives, providing accessible and customizable components.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="item-2">
    <Accordion.Trigger>How do I install it?</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Install via npm or pnpm: pnpm add @usefragments/ui
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="item-3">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Is it accessible?</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Yes! All components follow WAI-ARIA guidelines and support keyboard navigation.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion>

examples.name: Multiple Open
examples.description: Sections stay open so answers can be compared.
examples.code:
import { Accordion } from '@/components/Accordion';

<Accordion multiple defaultValue={['features', 'pricing']}>
  <Accordion.Item value="features">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Features</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Comprehensive component library with theming support, accessibility built-in, and TypeScript-first development.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="pricing">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Pricing</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Free and open source. MIT licensed for both personal and commercial use.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="support">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Support</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Community support via GitHub issues and discussions.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion>

examples.name: With Disabled
examples.description: An unavailable section stays visible but inert.
examples.code:
import { Accordion } from '@/components/Accordion';

<Accordion defaultValue={['available']}>
  <Accordion.Item value="available">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Notification preferences</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Choose which events send you an email and how often digests arrive.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="disabled" disabled>
    <Accordion.Trigger>Billing history</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Unavailable until a payment method is on file.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item value="another">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Connected accounts</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>
      Review the services linked to this workspace and revoke the ones you no longer use.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion>

relations.note: Use Tabs for horizontal switching between related views
Use Dialog for focused content that interrupts the flow
Accordion items can contain Card-like content

propsSummary: multiple: boolean - several items open at once (default: false)
headingLevel: 2-6 - the heading each trigger sits in (default: 3)
Accordion.Item disabled?: boolean - inert item, dimmed once
Accordion.Trigger forwards button props; Accordion.Content keepMounted?, hiddenUntilFound?
